patch_description: Replace the fixed cube-and-axis construction with a reproducible derivative-free maximin search initialized from that construction.  The previous arrangement is retained as the incumbent, so the search cannot return a worse configuration.  Batched Gaussian perturbations explore symmetry-breaking deformations of all 14 points, while the exact squared minimum-to-maximum distance ratio is used for acceptance.  The mutation scale adapts after successful steps and periodically reheats, allowing escape from the highly symmetric construction's local basin without depending on SciPy or nondeterministic global state.
